newsitem.title: PORTUGAL: Portuguese escudo steady at lower level on mark.
newsitem.headline: Portuguese escudo steady at lower level on mark.

text.p: The escudo was slightly easier against the mark on Thursday, compared with its Wednesday close, as the German currency advanced against the Spanish peseta.
Traders attributed the slightly softer tone to the approach of the long holiday weekend in Portugal with players unwilling to go short of marks.
The currency was at 100.23/26 to the mark against its 100.16/19 previous close but it was firmer than earlier lows around 100.38. Traders saw a trading range of 100.15-100.30 on Thursday.
